html:
3 days is not too long but enough for tourists to fully explore the beauty of Ninh Binh, visit famous landmarks and enjoy delicious food. Especially to take beautiful photos.

The most beautiful time to travel to Ninh Binh is from January to March of the lunar calendar. During this time, Ninh Binh is quite beautiful with cool weather, tourists can both visit and go to the temple to pray for good luck and a healthy and peaceful new year.

Traveling to Ninh Binh in early spring, tourists visit the ancient capital of Hoa Lu and immerse themselves in the festival taking place in early spring, a poetic and lyrical scene, in the spring weather.

The first stop on the Ninh Binh tour itinerary must be Mua Cave, this place is most beautiful in the early morning when the sunrise or sunset exudes a beautiful scene.

Mua Cave with its green mossy walls, next to ancient trees hundreds of years old, brings a unique beauty, both ancient and poetic.

The next destination is Co Vien Lau, one of the famous tourist destinations of Trang An, Co Vien Lau is an indispensable destination when having the opportunity to set foot in Ninh Binh. The place still retains the pristine beauty of a rustic village.

Bich Dong Pagoda, a place with both majestic and poetic landscapes, surrounded by towering limestone ranges, visitors can come here to visit, worship the temple, and burn incense to pray for peace.

Hoa Lu ancient town in early spring is sparkling in the light of lanterns, coming here visitors can experience releasing flower lanterns and sending wishes into them to pray for a healthy and happy new year.

To be satisfied with the beauty of Trang An, visitors should spend a session to fully explore the beauty, sit on a boat to admire the beauty and capture beautiful pictures for themselves.

The ancient capital of Hoa Lu is a destination for tourists who love to explore ancient beauty and learn about Vietnamese culture and history.

Tuyet Tinh Coc is a check-in point chosen by many tourists, with a vast blue lake of mountains and forests, visitors can walk through the stone steps and take beautiful pictures during their sightseeing journey at Tuyet Tinh Coc.

The last stop in the spring trip to Ninh Binh is Bai Dinh Pagoda, a pagoda with its own design, large campus, beautiful stupa, visitors can rent an electric car here for convenient sightseeing.

With the experience of traveling to Ninh Binh for 3 days and 2 nights, which Vietlook just suggested above, we hope to help you on your trip, wish you a happy trip.
